acts.name: I. The machine
acts.mood: dark product-film studio; slow, reverent close-ups of the hardware; quiet awe, building

acts.name: II. Ascent
acts.mood: hard cut into full-throated launch at sunset; power, scale; then the twilight 'jellyfish' plume high above: wonder

acts.name: III. Space
acts.mood: engines cut, sudden near-silence of space; weightless, vast, delicate; the second stage lights and leaves

acts.name: IV. Return
acts.mood: the booster turns for home; tension rising through the descent; triumph at touchdown; resolve and calm at the end card

shots.desc: fade up from black: the nine Merlin engines from below, a light sweeping across the bells
macro glide across a titanium grid fin
crane down the side past the SPACEX letters
orbit around the black interstage: latches, cold-gas thruster pod, grid fins
pull back to the full 70 m vehicle in rim light; title FALCON 9 at 19.0-23.5
hard cut: vehicle climbs past camera at sunset, plume blazing, camera shake
twilight wide shot: the plume blooms into a sunlit translucent jellyfish high in a dark sky
space above Earth's limb: MECO, stage separation, second-stage ignition
fairing halves fall away revealing the Starlink stack
booster flips with cold-gas puffs, grid fins deploy, heads home
sunset at sea: landing burn, legs deploy, touchdown on the droneship, steam
booster standing on the droneship at dusk; end titles; fade to black

events.desc: riser/swell peaks and cuts dead just before 24.0 (0.5 s of silence before the cut is fine)
HARD CUT: full engine roar (crackling, low, enormous), music hits
cut to far wide shot: roar becomes distant rumble, music opens up
main engine cutoff: everything except a faint high shimmer drops out instantly
pneumatic stage separation: one soft, low, muffled structure-borne thud
second-stage engine ignition: soft whump, then a low, felt-not-heard steady rumble
fairing separation: two soft pops 0.15 s apart
act IV begins: pulse/ostinato starts, tension rises from here
short hissing cold-gas thruster puffs (each 0.15-0.35 s)
cut to sunset at sea; landing-burn roar (single engine) builds as it approaches
landing legs deploy: pneumatic hiss and a heavy latch clunk at 54.4
touchdown: heavy impact thud; music peak / resolving chord
engine cuts off; hiss of steam, music sustains the resolution
fade to black and silence by 65.0
